The Wandsworth team was captained by Dave Grigg, the English International, and in the 100 yards Ted Read was beaten by inches by Jackson of Herne Hill in 10.4 secs. Len Marchant won the 880 in 2 min. 2 secs., with Norris second, and then E.
On May 12th, we had our now annual match against the Whitgift Middle School at Croydon. E.
Lockyer gave promise of better things to come and should both be troubling the best next season. Our young South African member, E.
Les Grimshaw finished second in the 100 yards, but pulled a muscle in the 220 and this trouble has kept him off the track since then. Vic Blowfield was third in the 880 and E.

It was a neck-and-neck struggle between South London Harriers and ourselves throughout, and our members can be said to have done well against such opposition. Ted Read ran second to Liffen of S.L.H. in the 100, while Jack Frost was second in the first strings 220 yards, and E.
Held at Tooting on July 14th, and once again we were poorly represented in the sprint events, although Les Christmas did well in gaining third place in both races. E.

Both the latter club and ourselves were poorly represented and as Herne Hill had Wilkinson and Higgins for the short sprints, they naturally scored major points in both these events. Len Marchant won the 880 in 1 min. 59.2 secs. and E.
